Primary use of a bed: Sleeping.

Interface Design for Music Streaming Service

1. Home Screen
- Minimalistic layout with a large album art display
- Quick access buttons for: Playlists, Radio Stations, Social Sharing
- Recent activity section showing recently played songs

2. Playlist Creation
- Simple drag-and-drop interface for adding songs
- Option to name playlists and add descriptions
- Auto-generated playlists based on listening history

3. Radio Stations
- Curated stations by genre, mood, or artist
- One-tap start button for immediate playback
- Option to save favorite stations

4. Social Sharing
- Share current song/playlist via social media platforms
- Collaborative playlist feature for friends
- Activity feed showing friends' listening activity

5. Navigation
- Bottom navigation bar with icons for: Home, Search, Library, Profile
- Swipe gestures for skipping tracks
- Voice command support for hands-free operation

6. Accessibility Features
- High contrast mode for visually impaired users
- Text-to-speech for screen readers
- Adjustable font sizes
- Colorblind-friendly palette options

7. Audio-Centric Design
- Waveform visualization during playback
- Volume control integrated into playback screen
- Equalizer settings accessible from main menu

8. Minimalistic Aesthetic
- Clean lines and ample white space
- Limited color palette focusing on brand colors
- Subtle animations for transitions
- No unnecessary clutter or distractions

9. Song/Album/Artist Navigation
- Unified search bar with predictive text
- Filter options for sorting results
- Detailed artist pages with discography and related artists

10. User Profile
- Customizable avatar and display name
- Listening statistics and achievements
- Privacy settings for social features
